name: Mondiad Advertising
author: Mondiad

sections.description:
Monetize Your WordPress Site Today

Mondiad Advertising is built for publishers who want a simple, reliable way to place ad codes on their WordPress site and start earning. Set up takes just a few minutes, and once you’re live, you have full control over how and where your ads appear.

The plugin connects your site to Mondiad’s ad network, giving you access to a wide range of formats:

  • Classic Push
  • In-Page Push
  • Native
  • Banner
  • Dynamic
  • Interstitial
  • Popunder (Soon)

You can match the right ad style to your audience and content. Customizable ad zones make it easy to fit ads naturally into your layout without disrupting the reader experience.

Why publishers choose Mondiad:

  • Quick installation, no coding required
  • Toggle your ad codes on or off without deactivating the plugin
  • Multiple ad formats and customizable placements
  • Global traffic coverage to maximize fill rates
  • Real-time reporting so you can track and optimize performance
  • Daily payouts with a low $10 minimum, including cryptocurrency options
  • Dedicated support team whenever you need help

Whether you’re running a blog, a content site, or a high-traffic publication, Mondiad gives you the tools to turn your audience into recurring revenue — without the hassle.
sections.installation:
1. Authorisation

  • Log into your Mondiad publisher account.
  • Go to Settings -> API integration -> Generate your API Key.
  • Enter your client ID/secret into the authentication form within the plugin.

2. Website selection

Submit your website or make your selection from your list of available websites.

The website URL from which you are searching will be prioritized.

3. Ad Zone configuration

After selecting your website (which will be shown right under our logo), it’s time to configure your ad zones.

The Default Ad Zone:

  • You can use an ad zone as a default for all your website pages via the “Use as default” button, at the end of it.
  • Once you set an ad zone as default, you’ll be able to remove it.
  • You can easily enable or disable ad zones at any time, via one click.
